name: Hotel Mercure Kourou Ariatel
desc: In the heart of a green and flowery oasis, the 80 renovated suites of the Mercure Kourou Ariatel hotel welcome professionals and travelers in search of authenticity for a unique immersive experience in French Guiana. Guests will enjoy a getaway from everyday life. The air-conditioned suites starting from 430 sq.ft., with lounge and dining area, guarantee optimal comfort for long stays.
